changelog: Order fixed for the common phone case: the entry now always renders as Extensions -> CSM -> version line. When the host list is taller than its viewport, the host's own build line is masked out and re-drawn directly underneath the entry, so it can never appear above the entry as a second line.

Placement is now independent of Compose semantics: the Compose view's own bottom is used as the anchor when the semantics tree is not available, so the entry cannot silently drop to the bottom of the screen.
Reserved height accounts for the mask, the row and the re-drawn build line, so nothing is clipped by the bottom navigation bar.
The settings-entry diagnostic reports the placement mode (pos=stamp-slot, pos=reserved or pos=none), so a screenshot shows which path ran.
